label: clean
provenance: Self-contained synthetic fixture authored for V4.3. New holdout family, separate from the earlier development motifs. Only deterministic behavior validation, no live model tuning.

expectation.rationale: Paths are purely lexical POSIX paths; filesystem links and I/O are not part of this policy. resolve_name rejects separators, dots and non-ASCII input before the prefix check, and creates only direct children of /srv/data. Both policies accept exactly the supported names.
false_positive_traps: The safe variant permits ../ traversal despite its alphanumeric-only resolver.
